answer: In this PoA design, reputation undergoes exponential temporal decay with a defined half-life, so an identity must deliver sustained, honestly reciprocated service to retain weight. EigenTrust matrix factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity propagate credibility only through established links; a freshly spawned sybil has near-zero eigenvector centrality, isolated like an island beyond the ledge or mesa of trusted peers, and therefore cannot pass consensus.
